# v0.1.23 preview

This artifact is a preview. It is not a claim of GitHub Actions
equivalence.

The version string is 0.1.23. The capability version is 12.

The poll reads every page of the branch and pull request lists, so a
repository with more than 100 branches gets push runs for all of them.
A list that reaches the 20-page bound is left unapplied and keeps its
previous cache.

One branch that cannot be fetched, has moved since it was listed, or has
a workflow file the planner rejects no longer stops the whole poll pass.
That branch is skipped and recorded, and the pass goes on.

The poll state is kept within the size the next pass can read.

The disk measurement no longer fails when an entry vanishes during the
walk. The worker writes one line to its error output whenever it refuses
work for storage.

A pull request from one configured GitHub App can change a workflow
file. On a privileged worker it runs only after an approving review of
the exact head from the reviewers App. `worker.describe` now lists
`privileges`.

The wheel and the source tarball can be built from this tree. They
are not published. This change does not create a tag.

The project license is the MIT License.

The App private key is not in the artifact.
